//: Editor/CI config for the bench examples. They import the BUILT artifact (../dist/esm/index.mjs) at runtime AND for types — TS resolves a .mjs import to its sibling .d.mts declaration (emitted via rslib dts.autoExtension), so a build is required before type-checking here. The root tsconfig.json only covers src/ (build-facing), so editors otherwise fall back to an inferred project here. Note: tsconfig paths mappings do not apply to relative imports, which is why the import is NOT remapped to src/.
